newsitem.title: USA: Synaptic says collaborating on Galanin.
newsitem.headline: Synaptic says collaborating on Galanin.

text.p: Synaptic Pharmaceutical Corp said Monday that it has entered into a collaborative research and licensing agreement with Warner-Lambert Co for researching the neurotransmitter, Galanin.
Synaptic said that it could recieve up to $34 million in milestone payments form Warner-Lambert for the first two compounds discovered that act upon receptors for Galanin.
Additional milestone payments for other drugs identified through the collaboration could be made as well, the company said.
Under the terms of the agreement, Warner-Lambert will retain exclusive worldwide rights to develop, manufacture and market any compounds developed through this deal.

Synaptic said so far most research of Galanin has focused on its role in food intake. The company says other areas where galanin research could potentially be applied is for Alzheimer's disease, depression, pain and endocrine disorders.
